summary: Answer strict run-wide workflow inventory count questions from the complete cached index without retrieval or a model call.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email efficiency, accuracy and adaptability
The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
Current source inspection proved that inventory counts did not load the workflow index and therefore could not be answered in Mock mode
approval_evidence: The persistent objective and project-question request authorize this deterministic accuracy and cost improvement.
known_limitations: Only exact English plural count forms for RFIs, Submittals and Emails use the deterministic shortcut.
RFI and Submittal totals count exact identifier groups, including reference-only identifiers whose primary source may be missing.
Email totals count only documents present in the selected analysis run; unimported attachments and mailbox content are excluded.
Filtered counts remain evidence/model questions and are not claimed complete by the workflow-index shortcut.
